sections.description: Scans your WordPress site for GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and EAA compliance gaps. Free checks: SSL, cookies, forms, backups, plugins, legal pages. Pro ($79/yr) auto-generates DPA, NIS2 clauses, EAA statements, and quarterly PDF reports.
sections.changelog:
= 1.2.0 =
* uninstall.php cleanup on deletion.
* Activation guard (PHP 7.4+/WP 5.8+).
* SSL check robustness for malformed URLs.
* Proper wp.org readme.txt sections and FAQ.

= 1.1.0 =
* Gumroad license API integration with caching and refund detection.
* Auto-update checker via update.json manifest.
* Improved license validation UX in settings.

= 1.0.0 =
* Initial release.
* Six compliance checks: SSL, cookies, forms, backups, plugins, legal pages.
* Weekly automated re-scan via WP-Cron.
* AJAX scan from admin dashboard.
* Pro license system with document generation.
